from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

class Judgment(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document classified by its cause of action."""
    title: str = Field(description="The exact title of the judgment document")
    category: Literal['知识产权与竞争', '不动产登记纠纷', '人格权纠纷', '与公司，证券，保险，票据等有关的民事纠纷', '执行案由 - 行政', '渎职罪'] = Field(description="The assigned cause-of-action category from the provided list")
    supporting_text: str = Field(description="Text evidence or key facts in the document that support the category assignment")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgments: list[Judgment]
